bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to agriculture; appropriating money for grants to the Minnesota Livestock Breeders Association.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; MINNESOTA LIVESTOCK BREEDERS ASSOCIATION. +]

[+$18,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $18,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of agriculture for grants to the Minnesota Livestock Breeders Association. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to agriculture; appropriating money for grants to the Minnesota Livestock Breeders Association.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; MINNESOTA LIVESTOCK BREEDERS ASSOCIATION.

$18,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $18,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of agriculture for grants to the Minnesota Livestock Breeders Association.
additions: $18,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $18,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of agriculture for grants to the Minnesota Livestock Breeders Association.
